facts.heading: Divorce from Radka
facts.content: Jana and Radka decided to divorce after 15 years of marriage. Jana still cannot understand the decision.
facts.evidence: After 15 years of marriage, Radka and I decided to divorce. And I still can't understand it.

facts.heading: Divorce happened in September
facts.content: Radek told Jana in September that it was not possible anymore.
facts.evidence: And in September he told me that it's not possible anymore.

facts.heading: Jana's emotional state
facts.content: Jana experienced feelings of emptiness and anger frequently.
facts.evidence: Empty. Then anger. Then again emptiness. 30 times a day.

facts.heading: Jana's reflection on marriage
facts.content: Jana thinks she should have seen the issues in their marriage.
facts.evidence: That I should have seen it, that I'm blind.

facts.heading: Jana's feelings about past actions
facts.content: Jana thinks she made a mistake and reflects on her own actions.
facts.evidence: I keep looking back in my head where I made a mistake.

facts.heading: Jana's feelings about being worried
facts.content: Jana sometimes thought she was too much worried.
facts.evidence: Sometimes I thought I was too much worried.

facts.heading: Children are a source of stress
facts.content: Jana feels suffering mainly because of her children.
facts.evidence: Yes, mainly because of the kids.

facts.heading: Jana has two children
facts.content: Jana has two children, Anička and Matěj.
facts.evidence: I have two kids. Anička is 12 and Matěj is 8 years old.

facts.heading: Anička asked about arguments
facts.content: Anička asked Jana if they were arguing with her father last week.
facts.evidence: Last week she asked me if we were arguing with dad.

facts.heading: Jana lied to Anička
facts.content: Jana lied to Anička about arguing with her father.
facts.evidence: I lied to her.

facts.heading: Anička perceived Jana's actions
facts.content: Anička saw Jana's feelings in her eyes. Jana feared destroying Anička's life.
facts.evidence: She saw it in my eyes. That I destroy her life.

facts.heading: Jana's fear of telling truth
facts.content: Jana is afraid of her children's tears when telling the truth.
facts.evidence: But I'm afraid of their tears.

facts.heading: Jana's plan for children
facts.content: Radek wants them to tell the children together, but they keep postponing it.
facts.evidence: Radek wants us to tell them together. we keep postponing it.

facts.heading: Jana's housing situation
facts.content: The apartment is on the mortgage, and Radek is getting married to his brother.
facts.evidence: The apartment is on the mortgage. Radek is getting married to his brother, at least so far.

facts.heading: Jana's fear of future role
facts.content: Jana is afraid she will not be able to manage things alone.
facts.evidence: I'm afraid I won't be able to do it myself.

facts.heading: Jana's occupation
facts.content: Jana works as a Czech teacher at a primary school in Brno.
facts.evidence: I work as a Czech teacher at a primary school in Brno.

facts.heading: Jana's teaching levels
facts.content: Jana teaches 9th and 8th graders.
facts.evidence: I teach 9th and 8th graders.

facts.heading: Struggles with studying
facts.content: Jana goes to class with a crutch in her neck. Jana feels like everyone sees her life is falling apart.
facts.evidence: I go to class with a crutch in my neck. I feel like everyone sees that my life is falling apart.

facts.heading: Teacher helped Jana
facts.content: Jana told the teacher about crying at the walk. The teacher let Jana leave earlier and gave her a free hour.
facts.evidence: I told her that because I once cried at the walk. She let me leave earlier, gave me a free hour

facts.heading: Work situation at home
facts.content: Jana was alone at work and had to do something. This made her feel worse.
facts.evidence: Because I was alone at work, I had to do something. but then I was sitting at home and it was worse.

facts.heading: Sleep schedule disruption
facts.content: Jana wakes up at 3 a.m. every night and thinks about what is next. Jana sleeps around 5 a.m. and gets up at 7.30 a.m.
facts.evidence: Every night I wake up at 3 a.m. and think about what's next. I sleep around 5 am and get up at 7.30 am.

facts.heading: Financial insecurity feelings
facts.content: Jana states she does not have a mortgage, a husband, or anything. She counts money and imagines telling her children.
facts.evidence: I don't have a mortgage, I don't have a husband, I don't have anything. I count the money and imagine how I will tell my children.

facts.heading: Weight loss and appearance
facts.content: Jana does not eat much and has lost 4 kilos. A friend tells her she looks terrible.
facts.evidence: I don't eat much. I lost 4 kilos. My friend tells me that I look terrible.

facts.heading: Support system contacts
facts.content: Jana has a sister in Olomouc who calls almost every evening. She also has a friend named Eva from work.
facts.evidence: I have a sister in Olomouc, she calls me almost every evening and my friend Eva from work.

facts.heading: Friend Eva's behavior
facts.content: Eva wants almost everything and wants Jana to have a hard time. Eva does not want Jana to think about anything.
facts.evidence: She wants almost everything. Eva just wants me to have a hard time. She doesn't want me to think about anything.

facts.heading: Fear of lying
facts.content: Jana is afraid of lying. She is afraid that a woman who cannot keep a marriage is not a good example for children.
facts.evidence: That I lied. That a woman who can't keep a marriage is not a good example for children.

facts.heading: Origin of belief about marriage
facts.content: Jana thinks the fear about marriage comes from her mum. Her mum always said marriage is a thing and what it is.
facts.evidence: Probably from my mum. She always said that marriage is a thing and that it's what it is.

facts.heading: Mother's interaction
facts.content: When Jana introduced her mother, the mother was silent. The mother then said she hopes Jana has been good to her.
facts.evidence: She was silent. Then she said that she hopes I've been good to her.

facts.heading: Mother's contact since
facts.content: The mother has not called Jana much since the introduction.
facts.evidence: She hasn't called me much since then.

facts.heading: Jana's current feeling
facts.content: Jana feels sad. She says she needs forgiveness.
facts.evidence: Sad. I need you to forgive me.

facts.heading: Jana's coping mechanism
facts.content: When Jana says what hurts out loud, she cries and apologizes. She says it helps a little.
facts.evidence: I cry and I apologize. It's nothing. Take your time. It's strange to sit here and say it out loud, but it helps a little.

facts.heading: Sleep help attempts
facts.content: Jana has tried cucumber tea for sleep. The doctor offered her some powder, but she does not want it.
facts.evidence: Cucumber tea and that's all. Doctor offered me some powder, but I don't want to.

facts.heading: Fear of dependency
facts.content: Jana is afraid she won't be able to wake up for her children in time. She does not want to be dependent.
facts.evidence: I'm afraid I wouldn't be able to wake up for my children in time and I don't want to be dependent.

facts.heading: Wakes Jana up
facts.content: Jana was asked to write down what wakes her up.
facts.evidence: write down what wakes you up?

facts.heading: Fear of panicking
facts.content: Jana is afraid of panicking and crying.
facts.evidence: That I'll panic and cry.

facts.heading: Fear of losing calm
facts.content: Jana is afraid she won't be able to stay calm.
facts.evidence: That I won't be able to stay calm.

facts.heading: Concern about children
facts.content: Jana is concerned about how children might react to her sadness.
facts.evidence: That it would be scary for them?

facts.heading: Ančka is sensitive
facts.content: Ančka is sensitive.
facts.evidence: Ančka is sensitive.

facts.heading: Goal to feel not alone
facts.content: Jana wants to feel not alone and not have to manage things right away.
facts.evidence: That I'm not alone and I don't have to manage it right away.
